title: glossary-artifact
description: Format contract of the user glossary, derived from reading the artifact on 2026-08-13: markdown, level-2 headed sections (Portuguese), each one 3-column table — correct name | transcription variants | context. Serves two index entries: the crossing (glossary-artifact) and the store (glossary-store), whose instance adds the store binding.

variant-separator.description: how one variants cell lists many transcription variants

store.description: the store binding, carried by the glossary-store entry's instance

location.description: where the artifact lives, as a config key — never a literal path

column-headers.description: the section's own header row wording; wording varies per section, the 3-column shape does not

variants.description: transcription variants; empty when the table cell is the em-dash placeholder
